scope.commuting_control: same real Gaussian covariance and means with zero commutator; temporal correlation alone does not distinguish this classical alternative
scope.controller: phase and latest detector bit select the native seam; forecasts read records only
scope.controls: conditional-field donor and unmeasured-field reset are explicit replacement services; neither occurs in the main process
scope.deletion: forecast-only record deletion leaves the actual source, field and action unchanged
scope.field: infinite-dimensional oscillator state represented by a bounded four-term Weyl word; no Fock cutoff
scope.halt: bounded continuing history, followed by halt and reread; no unbounded memory or repeated reset cycle
scope.memory: 8 bits encode 209 reached classical prefixes; program, source and field are separate resources
scope.numerics: floating full-mode execution checked against a separate directed rational two-read ideal-model certificate; numerical roundoff is not certified
scope.refinement: the attached certificate covers the fixed four-grid family; the grids list identifies the levels actually executed
scope.sampling: 50,000-trial default checks broad distribution agreement and does not resolve the small commutator backaction contrast
scope.state: same native loads and conditional field continue; one initial preparation per complete history
scope.time: supplied scalar model coordinate; native operation count is not physical duration
